text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Look, look~.
I posted a photo on Umastagram
before going to bed last night~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And then I got sooo many comments
from everyone... *sigh*. It was so fun~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you too, Onii-chan~.
Do you like... '#SleepyCurren'~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you too, Big Sis...
Do you like... '#SleepyCurren'~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Curren Chan hasn't been getting enough sleep...
